dossier.headline: India's IPO pipeline stays busy into mid-November
dossier.summary: India's primary market had a record July–September quarter, with about $9 billion raised and more than $13 billion for 2026, even as secondary-market stocks fell. Analysts flagged at the start of October that the heavy pipeline was absorbing liquidity just as FIIs sold. The next dated issue is Crystal Crop Protection's ₹456 crore IPO on November 18–20, while Carlsberg India has begun roadshows for an offer that could raise up to $600 million.
why_it_matters: A large IPO calendar competes with listed stocks for the same money
Analysts cited the pipeline's liquidity drain as one reason for the steep fall on October 1
More than 200 companies were in the pipeline at end-September, with Jio and Avaada among the big names
